prompt: When a Linear issue is closed, fetch all its comments using cursor pagination and post a single digest message to a Discord channel.

plan.summary: When a Linear issue transitions to closed, fetch all its comments via cursor pagination and post a formatted digest to a Discord channel.

source.docsQuery: Linear issue closed webhook payload fields issueId comments cursor pagination

target.docsQuery: Discord API post message channel ID content JSON payload

fieldMapping.note: Linear issue ID maps to Discord channel ID where the digest will be posted
Array of comment objects to be formatted into a single digest message string
Cursor string used to fetch the next page of comments via Linear API

assumptions: The Linear webhook payload includes the issue ID and an initial comment cursor or comment list.
The Discord bot has the 'Send Messages' permission in the target channel.
Comments are retrieved using Linear's cursor-based pagination endpoint for issue comments.
The integration will aggregate all comment bodies into one message, respecting Discord's message length limits.

Searched "Linear issue closed webhook payload fields issueId comments cursor pagination": 1 of 2 picked from Linear's own docs

notes: The webhook payload includes `action`, `type`, `data`, `createdAt`, and `webhookTimestamp`. For issue.closed, expect `data.state.type` to be 'done' or 'canceled' depending on workflow. Initial comments may not be included; use the Linear API to fetch comments via pagination.
Verify the `Linear-Signature` header using the webhook secret and ensure `webhookTimestamp` is within 60 seconds to prevent replay attacks.

example.content:
Digest of comments for Linear issue ISS-123:

- Comment 1: This is the first comment
- Comment 2: This is the second comment

notes: The `channelId` is required in the path and corresponds to the Discord channel where the message will be posted. The bot must have the 'Send Messages' permission in that channel.
Message content must be a string and cannot exceed 2000 characters. If the digest is longer, it must be split into multiple messages.
No additional fields are required in the request body for a basic text message.
